question: Which goddesses are invoked to protect the thighs and knees?
premises: Gaurī is invoked to protect the thighs
Kauṣikī is invoked to protect the pair of knees
inference: Gaurī is asked to always protect the thighs and Kauṣikī the pair of knees.
plain_english: May Gaurī always protect the thighs, and may Kauṣikī protect the pair of knees.
